papers.title_en: ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization
papers.authors: Ning Yang, Bohan Cui, Zhuowen Liu, Yuting Wang
papers.evidence: 用低秩修正重建 LLM 层中的激活量化残差误差
papers.tldr: 低比特权重-激活量化可降低大模型部署成本，但激活舍入会在校准后造成精度损失，且仅从舍入输入重建难以区分同一量化桶内激活。ResCom利用激活舍入残差做低秩校正，并通过输出感知校准按输出重构贡献选择方向、闭式求解补偿。在Llama-3-8B的4比特权重与激活下，WikiText-2困惑度由7.708降至7.147，MMLU提升2.89个百分点，GSM8K五样本准确率由23.96%升至36.16%。方法在1B至70B模型及C4上验证，兼顾精度恢复与部署可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. Evaluations on models from 1B to 70B parameters and on held-out C4 test the method beyond this setting. The evaluated FP32 implementation adds 2.25 percent to 4K prefill time; a separate compact-storage implementation retains a 27.7 percent peak-memory reduction relative to FP16.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Video Large Language Models: Methods, Trade-offs, and Evaluation
papers.authors: Yuqi Li, Chuanyue Yan, Neil Rodrigues, Xianglong Wang, Xiaoqin Feng, Junming Liu, Xi Xiao, Zhongwei Cheng, Wei Li, Lin Chen, Yingli Tian
papers.evidence: 综述视频大模型推理加速，涵盖视觉令牌精简与训练后量化
papers.tldr: 视频大模型处理长视觉序列时计算、延迟与内存开销高，训练无关推理加速成为重要方向。该综述按输入、视觉编码、投影器、预填充和解码等干预阶段梳理方法，并将训练后量化作为跨阶段扩展单独讨论。文章分析干预位置对时空证据保留与计算节省的影响，指出局部效率提升未必带来端到端加速，并用已有研究与统一实验的定量结果评估精度—延迟权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Video Large Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in video understanding and reasoning, but processing long visual sequences incurs substantial computational, latency, and memory overhead. This survey examines training-free inference acceleration, focusing on reducing inference costs while preserving task-relevant spatiotemporal evidence. We organize existing methods by their intervention stages in the inference pipeline, covering input, visual encoding, projector, prefill, and decoding. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is discussed separately as a cross-stage extension with varying calibration requirements. We analyze how intervention position affects evidence preservation and computational savings, and why local efficiency improvements may not translate into end-to-end acceleration. We complement this analysis with quantitative evidence from prior studies and our own experiments under a shared evaluation setting to assess accuracy-latency trade-offs.

papers.title_en: LearnPrunerV2: Learnable Progressive Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Rinyoichi Takezoe, Yaqian Li, Weiren Wang, Zihao Bo, Huihong Shi, Anzhou Hou, Mo Guang, Jiale Yan, Kaiwen Long
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言模型的可学习渐进式视觉token剪枝以减少冗余视觉token
papers.tldr: 针对视觉语言模型中视觉 token 数量庞大、剪枝标准不可靠且调度僵化的问题，LearnPrunerV2 将原有两阶段启发式框架扩展为全可学习架构。它在每层引入轻量模块，融合视觉显著性与通过 shadow token 获取的查询相关性来评估 token 重要性，并利用阶梯式冗余模式设计固定逐层预算的 BDP 调度。在 LLaVA-v1.5 上剪除 77.8% 视觉 token 仍保留 99.8% 原性能，取得更优精度-效率权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal capabilities but suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to the massive number of visual tokens. While token pruning is a promising solution, existing methods still suffer from two major drawbacks: 1) unreliable pruning criteria that fail to accurately localize task-specific regions due to inherent attention biases or query-agnostic designs, and 2) suboptimal pruning strategies that employ rigid, non-adaptive schedules, overlooking the dynamic evolution of token redundancy across different model depths. To address these challenges, we propose LearnPrunerV2, which extends the previous two-stage heuristic framework (LearnPruner) into a fully learnable architecture. Specifically, we integrate lightweight learnable modules into every layer of the VLM backbone, which estimate token importance by fusing intrinsic visual saliency with extrinsic query relevance captured via a shadow token. By uncovering a consistent staircase redundancy pattern across VLM layers, we further introduce Budget-Deterministic Pruning (BDP) to establish a hardware-friendly schedule with fixed per-layer budgets. Extensive experimental results across various benchmarks and VLMs demonstrate that LearnPrunerV2 consistently outperform previous state-of-the-art methods. Notably, LearnPrunerV2 preserves 99.8% of the original performance when pruning 77.8% of visual tokens on LLaVA-v1.5, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

papers.title_en: Mechanistic Insights into LoRA: Layer Sparsity for Adaptive Fine-Tuning via Path Patching
papers.authors: Fei Zuo, Yizhou Huang, Kezhi Wang
papers.evidence: 面向自适应参数高效微调的 LoRA 层稀疏性分析
papers.tldr: 标准全层LoRA忽略Transformer各组件贡献不均的问题。本文通过机制可解释性分析发现LoRA适配呈组件级和层级稀疏，且关键层高度依赖任务、跨任务重叠有限。作者提出校准驱动的Adaptive-LoRA，利用冻结基座零消融自动识别任务特定层。在Qwen2.5-1.5B的11项推理任务上，仅用30%层即超过全层LoRA，适配器参数减少3.5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA's adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a $3.5\times$ reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adaptive fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
papers.authors: Donghyeon Cho, Joowon Kim, Seungho Shin, Eunho Yang
papers.evidence: 扩散视觉语言模型中的视觉token剪枝与证书引导路由
papers.tldr: 扩散视觉语言模型在每步去噪都重复处理整幅图像，而视觉 token 占输入 89–97%，造成大量冗余计算。LOWN 在每步先无图预测掩码 token，仅当该预测与上次有图预测不一致时才处理图像，并用“认证”token 数决定本步解掩数量。无需训练或调阈值，在十个基准上保留 LLaDA-V 99.6% 得分，平均仅用 35.3% 解码 FLOPs。该证书引导视觉路由把按需看图变成自适应解码策略，并可推广到 LLaDA 系 DVLMs、与视觉 token 剪枝正交组合。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare LLaDA-V's predictions with and without the image at every decoding step and find that removing the image changes a token being unmasked at only 22.8% of steps on average and at as few as 7.9%. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs under key-value caching for further efficiency gains. Code and project page are available at https://hyeon9698.github.io/LOWN/

papers.title_en: CoS-VQ: Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zukang Xu, Zhixiong Zhao, Xing Hu, Zhe Jiang, Xin Si, Dawei Yang
papers.evidence: 基于向量量化的大模型低比特权重量化
papers.tldr: 大语言模型部署受权重内存制约，低比特向量量化常靠增大有效编码维度提精度，却增加查表与局部码字更新难度。CoS-VQ在保持低维码字的同时，联合优化硬索引与跨位置共享尺度，利用多探测尺度候选和切线可分离上界，将联合更新化为正尺度上直线下包络的有限区间搜索。在Qwen3.8-27B上，其语言建模、代码与推理表现优于QTIP和LLVQ，消融显示联合更新收益大于仅尺度细化。该工作为不增大码字维度的高效VQ提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) require substantial memory, motivating low-bit weight quantization for efficient deployment. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods often improve accuracy by increasing the effective coding dimension, which can complicate independent lookup and local codeword updates. We propose CoS-VQ (Coordinated Shared-Scale Vector Quantization), which preserves low-dimensional codewords while jointly optimizing hard indices and their shared scale across positions. The key challenge is scale-induced coupling: the optimal scale depends on the entire codeword combination and, in turn, changes candidate rankings across positions, so pointwise updates can stall even after scale re-optimization. CoS-VQ collects candidates at multiple probe scales and constructs a tangent separable upper bound for the residual-aware quadratic objective. By reducing candidate comparisons to lower envelopes of lines over positive scales, it identifies finitely many representative intervals for joint index--scale updates without exhaustively enumerating codeword combinations. On Qwen3.8-27B, CoS-VQ outperforms QTIP and LLVQ on the evaluated language modeling, coding, and reasoning benchmarks. Ablations from the same initialization further show larger gains from joint updates than from scale-only refinement, highlighting joint selection as an alternative to increasing codeword dimensionality. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/Cos_VQ.

papers.title_en: Error Diffusion Replaces Latent Weights: Training Binary-Weight Language Models on a Few Bits of Dithered State
papers.evidence: 通过量化残差训练状态实现二值权重语言模型的内存高效适配
papers.tldr: 二值权重语言模型部署时每权重仅存1比特，但训练仍保留全精度潜权重与Adam状态，约97比特，设备端难以继续适配。作者用2-8比特随机舍入残差缓冲替代潜权重，把图像半色调的误差扩散回路移到权重更新路径，形成ED优化器，并用阈值对齐规则决定翻转。二值MLP上4比特缓冲可匹配8比特；字符级Transformer收敛差距约1.7%，enwik8/wikitext-103扩展损失为参考的-2.3%至+2.9%。已部署模型能以约十分之一训练状态继续训练，并在275MB内存预算内完成CPU适配。
papers.abstract_en: Binary-weight language models store one bit per weight, but training them keeps a full-precision latent copy of each weight plus Adam state, about 96 extra bits per weight, so a deployed binary model cannot be adapted on the device that runs it. We replace the latent weight with a 2-8-bit residual buffer quantized by stochastic rounding, which cuts the training state per weight from 97 bits to 3-9, up to 19x less. The resulting error-diffusion (ED) optimizer moves the residual-carrying loop of image halftoning onto the weight-update path. Each buffer accumulates the unrealized part of every update and flips the weight when the accumulated value crosses a threshold, and it works only when its quantization grid has a level exactly at that threshold. Under this threshold-alignment rule, 4-bit buffers match 8-bit buffers on a binary multilayer perceptron benchmark, and the same rule lifts a different latent-free optimizer, Bop, from a 10-point deficit at 4 bits to full-precision accuracy. On character-level transformers with 97% of parameters binary, ED trains within 5-11% of the latent-weight reference at a 2,000-step budget and within 1.7% at convergence. On scaling ladders over enwik8 and wikitext-103, up to 19M parameters on enwik8 (70M with the wikitext-103 embeddings), the latent-free loss stays within -2.3% to +2.9% of the reference at all six sizes once a per-step cap on the buffer update removes a launch instability; without the cap it trails by 10% at the largest tokenized size. A deployed binary model continues training under ED at one tenth of the latent training state, matching latent-weight continuation, and a fused CPU kernel completes the adaptation within a 275 MB training-memory budget, which latent-weight training cannot. A 250-step probe sets the flip learning rate at any new scale.

papers.title_en: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
papers.authors: Tianqi Chen, Xunchao Li, Linchuan Xie, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng
papers.evidence: 大模型条件记忆的低比特量化与门控加权精度
papers.tldr: 条件记忆层为LLM挂载大规模哈希n-gram表，但低比特量化会先丢失长尾事实，按访问频率精化反而劣于随机精化。GateRQ指出检索行的量化误差受门控加权，门控可由1-bit码计算，因而按门控排序逐次读取残差码层级。它无需重训练，在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上将GPU表内存降7.8倍，vLLM吞吐提升11%-31%。以1.50比特/查询仅损失约1个PopQA点，2.10比特时损失0.2点，兼顾长尾知识保留与推理效率。
papers.abstract_en: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.
